## Grêmio v Internacional live, kick-off time and team news

Grêmio and Internacional meet in the year’s final Gre-Nal on Sunday at 17:30 at the Arena, the 455th edition in Brasileirão round 30.

According to Globo.com, RBS TV will broadcast in Rio Grande do Sul, with Premiere showing it across Brazil, and ge offering live text coverage.

## OneFootball Videos [...] Inter beat Corinthians 2-1 in Eduardo Baptista’s debut and are aiming to build momentum as he faces his first derby away. Anthoni remains in goal, and centre-back Victor Gabriel, cleared by the STJD, is vying with Juninho to start. ## Grêmio v Internacional: relegation stakes as 17th face 18th

Grêmio host Internacional in the Brasileirão on Sunday, 11 October 2026 at Arena do Grêmio, with both sides in the relegation zone and separated by one point.

Grêmio and Internacional met in the Copa do Brasil quarter-finals recently, drawing 0-0 on 27 August before Grêmio won 3-1 on 3 September. [...] Selection could matter. Imortal are without suspended midfielder Dodi, while Marlon, Jovane Cabral, Matheus Nascimento and Diego Caito are injured. Colorado list Antonio Sanabria, Sergio Rochet and Kayky as injured, with Victor Gabriel suspended. [...] In the table, Inter are 17th on 31 points and Imortal 18th on 30. A win for either could move the winner towards safety and push the other deeper into trouble in the bottom four.
